status: Implemented; focused, real HTTP fixture, and Worker runtime tests passed
scope: Window median/quantile numeric buffer admission through the query memory budget. Mode and distinct key storage remain open.
behavior: Reserve array overhead and each slot before creating or growing numeric state.
Drop backing array before releasing its merged reservation on reset or failure.
Sort admitted numeric state in place with constant-scratch heapsort instead of allocating a second full array.
Preserve append semantics after value evaluation because quantile state has no insertion-order semantics.

remoteCoverage: Real wide-timestamp Parquet over local HTTP 206 and ignored-range 200 responses: growing-frame median of a constant alongside decoded timestamp windows, four concurrent queries.
Native-emulated R2 Parquet in workerd: running 25th percentile of decoded ids 0..99, four concurrent queries at 64/128 MiB shared-pool caps.

limitations: Reservation units are not a portable VM heap ceiling.
Expression payload ownership and output arrays are not covered by this buffer reservation.
No production Cloudflare total-memory claim. Local admission-overhead benchmark is recorded separately.
performanceFinding: At 16384 unique numeric values, same-implementation admission diagnostic measured ~8.01ms admitted versus ~1.03ms unadmitted; explicit retained/peak buffer charge was 262208 bytes. Per-value reservation overhead needs amortization; no before/after or cloud-latency conclusion.
